creep: # may be an absolute or a relative path. ASPECT will write output such as

# Many large clusters use the Lustre file system (LFS) that allows to 'stripe'
# files, i.e., to use multiple file servers to store a single file. This is
# initialization and direct phase irreversibility restrictions. Particle
# stresses are derived samples. Resume/conversion is rejected. Particle
-    set Bulk history representation              = accepted FE strain  # default: particle stress
+    set Bulk history representation              = particle stress
